title: Episodic memory layer — PostgreSQL + pgvector ADDITIVE (memory_backend stays as short-term scratchpad)
goal: Add an episodic memory layer for (action, context, outcome, success_marker) tuples queryable via vector similarity. Per Codex refinement: ADDITIVE, NOT a replacement of memory_backend.py. File-backed memory_backend stays as short-term scratchpad; pgvector layer is for cross-advance and cross-run retrieval. Memory remains skeptical per Claude Code lessons — every retrieval is a HINT, evidence must still be verified.
scope: (1) Database migration: new `agent_episodic_memory` table with columns (id, run_id, engagement_id, action_type, action_context_jsonb, outcome_jsonb, success_marker, embedding vector(1536), created_at, is_benchmark). (2) New `api/app/services/episodic_memory.py`: write_episode(action, context, outcome) + recall_similar(query, k=5, filter_run_id=None) + skeptical_recall_with_verify_hint() that flags every result as 'hint, verify before use'. (3) Embeddings via configurable provider (default Anthropic via litellm — backlog-417 dependency met after that lands; for now OpenAI ada-002 via direct API). (4) Per Codex contamination guard: writes during benchmark mode tagged is_benchmark=True, NEVER returned to non-benchmark recalls. (5) memory_backend.py UNTOUCHED — file-memory blijft als short-term scratchpad per Codex refinement #3.
generation_reason: Per PentAGI architectuur: 3-layer memory (long-term vector + working context + episodic actions). Per Claude Code architectuur: Index-Based Skeptical Memory ('memory is hint, verify before action'). Currently AegisPT only has file-based memory_backend (short-term + persist). Missing the episodic+queryable layer needed for cross-run learning ('did I solve a similar challenge before?'). Per Codex refinement #3: ADDITIVE, not replacement. Per Codex contamination guard: benchmark vs production memory isolated.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md AND ANTI_DRIFT.md is loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Episodic layer ADDITIVE. memory_backend.py UNTOUCHED. Per Codex refinement: file-memory blijft scratchpad. Episodic = nieuwe queryable layer voor cross-run/cross-advance recall.
constraints.skeptical_memory: Per Claude Code architectuur: every recall returns results flagged as 'hint, verify before use'. recall_similar() return type explicitly carries verification_required=True flag. Caller is responsible for verifying before acting.
constraints.contamination_guard: Benchmark-mode writes tagged is_benchmark=True via thread-local context. recall_similar() in non-benchmark mode filters them out. Greppable test verifies benchmark solutions never appear in production recall.
